about: Polly's architecture: the one source the dependency check and the architecture view read (constitution VII). Tiers top first within each group. A path segment * makes one module per directory; a file belongs to the tier of its longest matching path. A change to this file carries its reason in the pull request.

tiers.name: Routes & workflows
tiers.criterion: One process each. Parse, authorize, call one flow, answer. Its main.ts, the composition root, alone wires the adapters.
tiers.isolated: Two processes never import each other: share through a package below.
tiers.fix: A route calls one flow; only a composition root (main.ts) imports an adapter package, and hands what it builds to the flows through their ports.
tiers.typesFix: A route uses a domain's types only: what it needs done goes through a flow.
tiers.technologyFix: A route speaks HTTP or MCP and validates with Zod; any other technology sits in a capacity package, behind a port.

tiers.name: Flows
tiers.criterion: One use case each: chain domain calls through their ports, compute nothing, no technology.
tiers.isolated: Two flows never import each other: compose them in the process that calls them.
tiers.fix: A flow chains domains and computes nothing: move the computation into a domain, the technology into a capacity package behind a port.
tiers.typesFix: A flow imports only types from the kernel: a value it needs comes from a domain.
tiers.technologyFix: A flow knows no technology: declare a port in the domain it calls and implement it in a capacity package.

tiers.name: Domains
tiers.criterion: Product rules. A domain declares a port (an exported interface, in its own words) for what it needs; no technology, no Node built-in.
tiers.isolated: Two domains never import each other: declare a port in the importing domain and feed it from a flow.
tiers.fix: A domain imports only the kernel and the socle.
tiers.technologyFix: A domain knows no technology: declare a port and implement it in a capacity package.

tiers.name: Adapters
tiers.criterion: One package per capacity, named by what it provides: implements the domains' ports with one technology. May depend on a lower capacity, never in a cycle.
tiers.fix: An adapter implements ports: it imports the domains' types, the kernel, the socle and lower capacities, nothing above.

tiers.name: Kernel
tiers.criterion: Polly's pure values (ids, the event code, scores) and the one hash function. No rule, no other technology.
tiers.fix: The kernel holds values: a rule goes to a domain.
tiers.technologyFix: The kernel uses node:crypto for its hash and nothing else.

tiers.name: Socle
tiers.criterion: What every process shares, with no product word and no chosen technology: Refusal, the Logger and Clock ports, the configuration schema.
tiers.fix: The socle imports nothing of Polly.
tiers.technologyFix: The socle chooses no technology beyond the schema library.

tiers.name: Contract
tiers.criterion: Generated from the API's routes: its client, its schemas and the refusal codes. Never edited by hand.
tiers.fix: The contract is generated and imports nothing of Polly.

tiers.name: Web app
tiers.criterion: The front end's entry: providers, router, global styles.
tiers.fix: Feature-Sliced Design: a layer imports only the layers below it.

tiers.name: Web pages
tiers.criterion: One screen each.
tiers.isolated: Two pages never import each other: move what they share down a layer.
tiers.fix: Feature-Sliced Design: a page imports only the layers below it.

tiers.name: Web widgets
tiers.criterion: Self-contained blocks of a page.
tiers.isolated: Two widgets never import each other: move what they share down a layer.
tiers.fix: Feature-Sliced Design: a widget imports only the layers below it.

tiers.name: Web features
tiers.criterion: One user action each.
tiers.isolated: Two features never import each other: compose them in a widget or a page.
tiers.fix: Feature-Sliced Design: a feature imports only entities and shared.

tiers.name: Web entities
tiers.criterion: Product objects as the front end shows them.
tiers.isolated: Two entities never import each other: compose them in a feature.
tiers.fix: Feature-Sliced Design: an entity imports only shared.

tiers.name: Web shared
tiers.criterion: No product word: the API client, i18n, UI primitives.
tiers.isolated: Two shared segments never import each other: merge them or split what they share.
tiers.fix: Shared knows no layer above it.

tiers.name: Plugin
tiers.criterion: The Claude Code plugin's scripts: the monitor. Reaches Polly through the generated contract only.
tiers.fix: The plugin reaches Polly through the generated contract only.
tiers.technologyFix: The monitor is bundled from Node built-ins and the contract only.

tiers.name: Dev entry
tiers.criterion: The dev commands' composition root: parses the command line, wires the real adapters.
tiers.fix: The dev entry wires the tiers below it.

tiers.name: Dev commands
tiers.criterion: One command each (up, down, worker, e2e, url, agent), written against the ports.
tiers.fix: A dev command imports only the dev tiers below it.

tiers.name: Dev end-to-end
tiers.criterion: The driven agent run and its scenarios.
tiers.fix: The driven run imports only the dev tiers below it, and the demo account's definition.

tiers.name: Dev worktree
tiers.criterion: A worktree's state: its lock, its recorded resources, its session.
tiers.fix: The worktree tier imports only the dev tiers below it.

tiers.name: Dev supervisor
tiers.criterion: The process group holding a worktree's processes.
tiers.fix: The supervisor imports only the dev tiers below it.

tiers.name: Dev infrastructure
tiers.criterion: The adapters of the shared infrastructure: compose, Postgres, Garage, portless.
tiers.fix: An infrastructure adapter imports only the dev tiers below it.

tiers.name: Dev machine
tiers.criterion: What the machine provides: prerequisites, locks, dependencies.
tiers.fix: The machine tier imports only the dev tiers below it.

tiers.name: Dev ports
tiers.criterion: The interfaces the commands use, which the infrastructure and the fakes implement.
tiers.fix: The ports import only the dev tiers below them.

tiers.name: Dev configuration
tiers.criterion: The worktree's .env.local and its template.
tiers.fix: The configuration imports only the identity and the kernel.

tiers.name: Dev identity
tiers.criterion: A worktree's identity and the resource names derived from it.
tiers.fix: The identity imports only the kernel.

tiers.name: Tools
tiers.criterion: Tooling ready to leave for a repository of its own: imports nothing of Polly.
tiers.fix: A tool imports nothing of Polly: it reads Polly's files, never its code.

@polly/database.provides: connection, table types, all SQL, schema check

@polly/migrations.runOnly: @polly/migrations is run (its command), never imported: check the schema through @polly/database.

@polly/identity.provides: who makes a request: Better Auth and the token exchange

@polly/analysis.provides: the compute service's client and the fake analyzer

@polly/platform.provides: Refusal, the Logger and Clock ports, the configuration schema

@polly/contract.provides: the API's generated client and refusal codes

@polly/dev.runOnly: The dev commands are run, never imported: an app never depends on the development environment.

root.fix: The root manifest holds only the whole project's tools: declare the dependency in the package that imports it.
